remarks: Impeccable three-bedroom home in Randolph. Located on a neighborhood street, this home will satisfy your desire for small-town life, while still being a short drive from I-86, putting city amenities in easy reach. Inside, the cool color palette and spacious rooms give the interior an airy and open feel. The main floor has a primary bedroom with an en-suite bath. The country kitchen has a breakfast bar and solid-surface counters, and is spacious enough to include a dining nook. The formal dining room has built-ins to display your china. The living room features a gas fireplace and a wall of built-in storage, the perfect place for your movies or books. The main floor also has a media room that could be an office, a laundry room, and a storage room. Upstairs there are two more spacious bedrooms and a second full bath. Outside, there is a covered porch and a deck overlooking the backyard. This property also features an extra-large, two-car garage with electrical service and heat. The garage also has workshop space and storage, with an open second floor.
